verdict.rationale: Cactus ships non-GUI entry points that run headlessly: a brew-installed CLI (`cactus run`, `cactus benchmark`, `cactus convert`), Python bindings, and an engine with OpenAI-compatible APIs. The local package runs on Linux/macOS/Windows on Arm and x86 with no GPU. However, nothing documents deploying it on servers or in CI pipelines, and the marketing stresses on-device use with 'no server'. missing for 10: explicit server/CI deployment docs, documented headless server mode (e.g. an HTTP serve command), hands-on corroboration of server/CI use
